items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: He played with Chris and with me, most of the time with Rene and different fellas.

ctx.x: in that band too. Where was he from, Flowers? The West Indian. That you make our song. That's right. Let's see. Got to check all this. Uh. When the secretary comes, we got your name and an index here. We want to check that over. Let me see. So you played with the Pacific, Eureka?

That's right, Tuxedo, when Eddie Jackson takes over. Yeah. I played with Eureka. Who was this guy, Gassoon? Gassoon was a banjo man. I met him on my way coming up, but he had to go to the clinic. Other than that I'd have brought him over. Well who was? I mean Gassoon, his name is Joe Phillip. But did he play in the brass band? No, no, he played in the band. He played with Chris and with me, most of the time with Rene and different fellas.
Let me find something from the interview that Bill did with you. Hold on a second. When you came into the Eureka, what part did they give you?
